security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' doc: http://doc.localhost blob: data:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost doc: http://doc.localhost https://api.github.com; worker-src 'self' blob:; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

bundle.shortDescription: Tiny PDF, image and markdown viewer with one-second live reload
bundle.longDescription: pdf-next opens PDFs, images and markdown, follows your system dark mode, searches text, and reloads within a second of the file changing on disk — built for the LaTeX, Typst and markdown compile loop.
